TranslationContext: This file contains Unit Names for the Knights of Avalon Faction.

Translations.Comment: 騎士 = knight. Noble warriors of legendary kingdom Avalon.
民兵 = militia. Citizen soldiers with swords.
農民 = peasant, 群れ = mob/horde. Untrained levy troops.
戟 = halberd/pike. Militia armed with pole weapons.
槍 = spear. Basic militia formation troops.
志望者 = aspirant/candidate. Young warriors training for knighthood.
騎馬 = mounted, 狩人 = hunter. Light cavalry scouts.
誓約 = sworn oath. Knights bound by sacred vows.
狩猟犬 = war dog/hunting hound. Animals in battle service.
狩人 = hunter. Skilled scouts and archers.
トレビュシェ = trebuchet (katakana). Siege catapult.
ロングボウ = longbow. Elite archers with powerful bows.
近衛兵 = royal guard. Elite warriors protecting royalty.
ペガサス = pegasus (katakana). Flying cavalry knights.
ヒッポグリフ = hippogryph (katakana). Gryphon-horse hybrid mount.
ペガサス = pegasus. Mythological winged horse.
ユニコーン = unicorn (katakana). Magical pure creature.
乙女 = maiden, 聖騎士 = holy knight. Divine warrior blessed by heaven.
パラディン = paladin (katakana). Holy knight champion of righteousness.
